findings.text: 适合反复按岗位修订履历、愿意核实事实与最终文件的人；合格成果是可发送且可追溯的文档。它是独立客户端应用，不能直接当DSH插件加载。见[Q01](#research-q01)。
编辑器将本地修改排队保存；界面助手经真实模型工具循环提出可接受的局部改动，外部MCP则按凭据权限直接调用API。两种写入的确认方式不同，保存状态与最终导出还需分别核对。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)、[Q04](#research-q04)。
完整固定版本inventory；定向核根manifest/README、HTTP/MCP认证与注册、履历更新/补丁事务、客户端保存恢复、文档助手工具循环与提案接受、PDF下载/界面导出和检查调用。未全审1718个文件的全部实现、模板字体、移动端、职业分支、OAuth发行和provider存储；未执行目标代码或宿主验收。
根private包6.0.7、MIT，声明Node24与pnpm12.16.1；独立应用源码和多部署方式，不是DSH安装包。固定提交不等当前云服务/镜像字节已验收。
成本主要由数据整理、事实复核与运维/恢复构成，按次模型限额并非总费用上限；应按每份合格文档核算，而非把免费声明当零成本。四阶段明细见[Q06](#research-q06)。
先限定虚构履历、单标签、非AI编辑/导出，基础通过后再单独授予MCP写或模型访问；出现事实/保存/文件异常即撤权并回独立文档。验收和停止标准见[Q07](#research-q07)。
当前能确认的是接口与状态可检查性；规则分和提案数都不能替代最终文件与真实任务结果。效果表见[Q06](#research-q06)，可推翻的比较方案见[Q07](#research-q07)。
事务内内容与版本记录、明确离线状态及提案后接受值得借鉴；仍须保留可选版本条件、旧凭据全权限和最终文件身份的边界，不把更丰富的状态日志误当更强交付保证。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q05](#research-q05)。
在同一文档对象上接好保存、检查、版本及机器接口；内置助手把建议与用户接受分开，MCP写入把归属与事务串起来。增量在可检查的流程组合，不在模板数量或协议原创；依据见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q05](#research-q05)。
保存成功、提案接受、规则分和PDF下载是不同收据：自动保存未发送可选版本条件，旧凭据可能全权限，短期下载未绑正文版本。不能据任何单一成功标志推断无覆盖、事实正确或错版不会发送。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)、[Q05](#research-q05)。
可验证的后续方向是把事实基线、已保存版本与最终PDF提取摘要绑定为放行收据，比较错事实、错版本和修正时间。已有提案/版本/提取提供锚点，但自动绑定与净收益均未验证；无改善或负担过高即否定，详见[Q07](#research-q07)。
先选择云账号或自托管路径，再核数据库/认证与存储条件；MCP凭据和AI provider是各自阶段的附加条件，不能随基础编辑一并放行。完整条件表见[Q06](#research-q06)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)成熟编辑/协议/模型组合，novelty9超过无组件增量0但不到新机制18；[Q02](#research-q02)与[Q04](#research-q04)提案、保存和版本约束构成实质接线，mechanism15超过单入口8，未验复杂故障不进23。[Q03](#research-q03)归属/定向修改可迁移但受文档Schema绑定，transferability10超过仅本应用5、不足广泛复用15；[Q06](#research-q06)集中流程有简化8，完整服务运维与核事实负担使其不进11，而非只有局部美化4。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)与[Q02](#research-q02)到[Q05](#research-q05)把修改、检查和最终导出组织为同一主工作流，workflow26超过部分环节18，未验证真实求职闭环不进35。多格式/机器接口交付15超过单输出8，版本未自动绑定发送且无对照不进23；[Q03](#research-q03)外部接口和自托管降低部分接入限制，reach10超过单入口5，未有新增人群验证不进15。[Q06](#research-q06)开放许可/自带provider改变支出归属，economics4超过未识别结构变化0；备份、调用与返工成本不明，不进8或声称净省钱。

recommendation.reason: 需要按岗位反复修订履历并愿意核实事实和文件的用户，可先用虚构履历试用非AI编辑、保存与PDF导出。相对文档编辑器加岗位表，源码接好多种文档修改和检查接口，但尚未证明净节时或招聘收益。如果保存版本不明、出现虚构事实或PDF内容异常，应停止外部写入并退回已核实的独立文档。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)有按岗位反复修订及最终文件的明确任务，并由保存/检查接口适配，超过一般便利15；无真实用户关键需求/结果证据，23不进30。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)至[Q05](#research-q05)共用结构化文档、版本、检查和机器接口，比Word加岗位表少若干手工转写，超过局部入口13；未比较净节时且错版边界存在，19不进25。

evidence.rationale: 实际追到保存调用/状态、MCP注册/归属/事务/结果、模型工具循环与两种PDF路径，核心机制超过零散声明6；[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q05](#research-q05)同时有反证，源码证据取13上限，不以作者测试或计数进入运行证据19。

cost.rationale: [Q06](#research-q06)可先非AI、导出JSON/文档并撤权，退路明确，超过关键恢复条件缺失5；自托管、隐私审阅、事实校对和资源金额未知，10不进较轻且可预期负担15。

publication.summaries.text: 独立开源求职应用，支持履历和求职信编辑、文档检查、投递记录及可选AI与MCP接口。

items.界面: 独立履历编辑、保存状态、建议接受/撤销与文件导出界面。
items.模型工具: MCP通过API凭据提供文档读写、检查与导出接口。
items.Agent/Preset: 应用内文档助手接模型工具循环、局部提案与搜索批准；非DSH预设。

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 文档编辑与恢复 | 结构化修改、保存和设备草稿 | 本地副本有条件/期限，并发版本条件不默认发送 |
| 检查与导出 | 内容规则、岗位词项、PDF及多格式文档 | 不保证事实、所有ATS或招聘效果；双导出路径另验 |
| 文档助手 | 工具循环读取文档、提案后接受 | provider可选，外发范围、事实与保存需核实 |
| MCP接口 | 外部Agent读写和检查文档 | 凭据权限、用户归属及可选版本条件；直接写不是界面提案 |

publication.advice.text: 先限定虚构履历、单标签、非AI编辑/导出，基础通过后再单独授予MCP写或模型访问；出现事实/保存/文件异常即撤权并回独立文档。验收和停止标准见[Q07](#research-q07)。

Download a PDF, Word, Markdown, or JSON file, or share your resume with a public link. You can also run the whole application on your own infrastructure.\n\nYou own your data. The codebase is open source under the MIT license, with no tracking, no ads, and no paid tier. Optional AI features use a provider you connect; hosting and provider usage may have their own costs.\n\n![Reactive Resume v6 editor with Write, Design, and Check modes and a live PDF preview](docs/images/getting-started/editor-overview.webp)\n\n## Build a better resume, together\n\n[Join the Reactive Resume community on Discord](https://discord.gg/u9pAd3za9t) to exchange resume feedback, get help using or self-hosting the app, and share ideas with other users and contributors.\n\n- **Resume feedback:** post a redacted resume and one specific question, or help someone improve theirs.\n- **Help:** find troubleshooting discussions and ask questions in dedicated forum threads.\n- **Contribute:** discuss ideas, translations, and code with the people building Reactive Resume.\n\nFeedback comes from fellow community members. Remove contact details and other private information before posting.\n\n## Features\n\n**Write, Design, and Check**\n\n- Redesigned editor with inline content editing and click-to-select on the page\n- Live PDF preview and browser downloads powered by Forme, rendered in a background worker\n- Rich text, custom sections, drag-and-drop ordering, and structured dates with consistent formatting\n- Autosave, local recovery of unsaved resume drafts, and up to 200 undo steps\n- Phone and tablet layouts, keyboard shortcuts, and a searchable command bar\n\n**Templates and Customization**\n\n- 18 templates, including the new Porygon and Smeargle, previewed with your own content\n- One-column, two-column, and ATS-safe template filters\n- Font presets, custom fonts, colors, spacing, A4 and Letter paper, and left or right sidebars\n- Fit overflowing content by adjusting density, margins, and text size\n- Custom Styles written as Semantic CSS, with an element picker on the page\n\n**Resume Checks**\n\n- Readability checks with findings pinned to the relevant lines\n- Job-posting keyword matching and a view of the text hiring software reads\n- Checks on the exported PDF, plus an optional AI writing review\n- A public [ATS checker](https://rxresu.me/ats-checker) that reads PDFs in your browser without an account\n\n**Documents and Cover Letters**\n\n- One searchable library for resumes and letters, with tags, sorting, and grid or list views\n- Standalone cover letters with their own editor, exports, and version history\n- Link a letter to a resume to keep its sender details and design in sync, or customize it independently\n- Automatic and named versions you can preview and restore\n- Trash with Undo and a 30-day recovery window\n\n**Job Applications**\n\n- List, Board, Insights, and Calendar views for tracking applications from Saved to Offer\n- Save jobs from a URL or pasted posting; optional keyword search through Firecrawl, Tavily, or Exa\n- Tailor a resume and draft a cover letter for a saved job\n- Track contacts, notes, follow-ups, application outcomes, and the documents you sent\n- Schedule interviews, export calendar events, and import or export applications as CSV\n\n**AI Assistant**\n\n- Assistant beside your resume or letter, with conversations tied to that document\n- Proposed edits show what changes and why; accept or reject each suggestion\n- Improve selected text, review writing, and draft letters from a resume and job posting\n- Connect OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, or other supported providers and compatible endpoints\n- Optional web search and page reading; self-hosters can configure shared AI and web-access providers\n\n**Import, Export, and Sharing**\n\n- Import Reactive Resume JSON, JSON Resume, LinkedIn data exports, PDF, and Word files\n- JSON, LinkedIn, and readable PDF imports work without AI; Word imports require a connected provider\n- Export resumes and letters as PDF, Word (DOCX), Markdown, or JSON\n- Share resumes through public links with optional password protection and view/download statistics\n- REST API and MCP server for document management, imports, exports, checks, and application workflows\n\n**Privacy and Control**\n\n- Self-host with Docker, Vercel, Cloudflare Workers, or a 1-click deploy on Hostinger\n- No tracking or ads; export your account data or delete your account\n- Passkeys, two-factor authentication, and linked sign-in providers\n- Multiple interface languages, light/dark/system themes, and reduced-motion app](https://rxresu.me) to start writing, or build this checkout locally with Docker and Docker Compose:\n\n```bash\n# Clone the repository\ngit clone --depth=1 https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume.git reactive-resume\ncd reactive-resume\n\n# Create your local configuration\ncp .env.example .env\n# Edit .env: set AUTH_SECRET and a separate ENCRYPTION_SECRET.\n# Generate each secret with: openssl rand -hex 32\n\n# Build the app and start PostgreSQL, Redis, and SeaweedFS\ndocker compose up -d --build\n\n# Open http://localhost:3000 in your browser\n```\n\nThis builds the checked-out source. For a deployment using published images, follow the [Docker guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/docker). For source development, see the [development setup guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/contributing/development).\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n| Category         | Technology                               |\n| Self-Hosting\n\nReactive Resume runs the same application everywhere: PostgreSQL for data, plus storage for uploads. Pick the option that fits how much you want to manage.\n\n| Option                                          | Best for                                      | Guide                                                                                                               |\n| ----------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| [Hostinger](#hostinger)                         | A ready-made VPS with no setup                | [Hostinger guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/hostinger)                                                    |\n| [Vercel](#vercel)                               | Serverless, with managed database and storage | [Vercel guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/vercel)                                                          |\n| [Cloudflare Workers](#cloudflare-workers)       | Workers, R2 and your own PostgreSQL           | [Cloudflare guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/cloudflare)                                                  |\n| [Docker and Kubernetes](#docker-and-kubernetes) | Your own server, homelab or cluster           | [Docker](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/docker) · [Kubernetes](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/kubernetes) |\n\n> **PDF generation in v6** uses Forme in the browser and on the server. No Browserless, Chromium, or external print service is needed. Legacy `PRINTER_*` and `BROWSERLESS_*` environment variables can be removed.\n\n### Hostinger\n\nThe quickest way to get going is a 1-click deploy on Hostinger, starting at $6.49/month. Their VPS plans include a ready-made Reactive Resume template that provisions the Docker environment and brings the app up for you, with weekly backups and a Docker manager UI included — so you can skip the setup entirely.\n\n<a href=\"https://www.hostg.xyz/aff_c?offer_id=48&aff_id=232413&url_id=6857\">\n  <img src=\"https://assets.hostinger.com/vps/deploy.svg\" alt=\"Deploy on Hostinger\" width=\"148\" height=\"32\" />\n</a>\n\nSee the [Hostinger guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/hostinger) for what the template sets up and what to configure afterwards, such as email, your own domain, and turning off sign-ups.\n\n### Vercel\n\n[![Deploy with Vercel](https://vercel.com/button)](https://vercel.com/new/clone?repository-url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Freactive-resume%2Freactive-resume&project-name=reactive-resume&repository-name=reactive-resume&env=AUTH_SECRET%2CENCRYPTION_SECRET&envDescription=Generate+two+independent+secrets+with+openssl+rand+-hex+32.+Keep+these+values+across+deployments.&envLink=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.rxresu.me%2Fself-hosting%2Fvercel&stores=%5B%7B%22type%22%3A%22integration%22%2C%22protocol%22%3A%22storage%22%2C%22integrationSlug%22%3A%22neon%22%2C%22productSlug%22%3A%22neon%22%7D%2C%7B%22type%22%3A%22integration%22%2C%22protocol%22%3A%22storage%22%2C%22integrationSlug%22%3A%22upstash%22%2C%22productSlug%22%3A%22upstash-kv%22%7D%2C%7B%22type%22%3A%22blob%22%2C%22access%22%3A%22private%22%7D%5D)\n\nVercel provisions Neon PostgreSQL, private Blob storage, and Upstash Redis through its deployment wizard. Supply two persistent secrets and use the **Services** framework preset. Static assets run in the frontend service, and Hono serves the application routes and APIs from the backend service. See the [Vercel guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/vercel) for setup, limits, and optional SMTP/OAuth configuration.\n\n### Cloudflare Workers\n\nCloudflare deployment requires **Workers Paid** and uses Static Assets, private R2 storage, SQLite Durable Objects, and PostgreSQL through Hyperdrive. Supply an existing PostgreSQL database and apply migrations before deployment. See the [Cloudflare guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/cloudflare) for setup and runtime limits.\n\n### Docker and Kubernetes\n\nThe application needs:\n\n- **PostgreSQL** — Accounts, documents, applications, and assistant conversations\n- **Upload storage** — A persistent local directory or an S3-compatible bucket, such as SeaweedFS\n- **Redis** (optional) — Shared coordination across instances and resumable assistant replies\n- **SMTP** (optional) — Verification and password-reset emails\n\nPublished releases are available from Docker Hub and GitHub Container Registry (`latest` tracks the latest stable release):\n\n```bash\n# Docker Hub\ndocker pull amruthpillai/reactive-resume:latest\n\n# GitHub Container Registry\ndocker pull ghcr.io/reactive-resume/reactive-resume:latest\n```\n\nSee the [Docker guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/docker) or [Kubernetes guide](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/kubernetes) for complete instructions. Running on a NAS? See the [Synology and UGREEN guides](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/nas).\n\n### Configuration\n\nEvery setting is listed in the [environment variables reference](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/environment-variables). Self-hosters can also configure [shared AI and job-search services](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/job-search-and-ai) and [single sign-on](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/sso).\n\n### Upgrading from v5\n\nBack up your database and uploads and stop all v5 instances before applying v6 migrations. Follow [Migrating from v5](https://docs.rxresu.me/self-hosting/upgrading-to-v6).\n\n## Support\n\nReactive Resume is and always will be free and open source. Http2Bindings };\n\nconst getTrustedClient = (context: Context<ServerEnvironment>, proxies: BlockList): string => {\n\ttry {\n\t\tconst address = getConnInfo(context).remote.address?.trim();\n\t\tif (!address || !isIP(address)) return \"unknown\";\n\t\tconst trusted = (ip: string) => proxies.check(ip, isIP(ip) === 4 ? \"ipv4\" : \"ipv6\");\n\t\tif (!trusted(address)) return address;\n\t\tconst forwarded = context.req.header(\"x-forwarded-for\");\n\t\tif (!forwarded) return address;\n\t\tconst chain = forwarded.split(\",\").map((ip) => ip.trim());\n\t\tif (chain.some((ip) => !isIP(ip))) return address;\n\t\tlet client = address;\n\t\tfor (const hop of chain.reverse()) {\n\t\t\tif (!trusted(client)) break;\n\t\t\tclient = hop;\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn client;\n\t} catch {\n\t\treturn \"unknown\";\n\t}\n};\n\ntype AppOptions = {\n\tserveStatic?: boolean;\n\ttrustedClient?: (request: Request) => string;\n\treadWebFile?: ReadWebFile;\n};\n\nexport function createApp(options: prefix] = range.split(\"/\");\n\t\tif (!address) continue;\n\t\tconst family = isIP(address) === 4 ? \"ipv4\" : \"ipv6\";\n\t\tif (prefix === undefined) proxies.addAddress(address, family);\n\t\telse proxies.addSubnet(address, Number(prefix), family);\n\t}\n\tconst client = (c: Context<ServerEnvironment>) => options.trustedClient?.(c.req.raw) ?? getTrustedClient(c, proxies);\n\n\t// The alias domain serves the same public pages; only the signed-in app's sections move to APP_URL.\n\tapp.use(\"*\", async (c, next) => handleAlias(c.req.raw) ?? (await next()));\n\t// A verified custom domain shows its primary resume; other hosts fall through.\n\tapp.use(\"*\", async (c, next) => (await handleCustomDomain(c.req.raw, client(c))) ?? next());\n\n\tapp.use(\"/auth/*\", async (c, next) => {\n\t\tawait next();\n\t\t// The app shell already carries a full policy that forbids framing; only add one where it's missing.\n\t\tif (!c.res.headers.has(\"Content-Security-Policy\")) c.header(\"Content-Security-Policy\", \"frame-ancestors 'none'\");\n\t\tc.header(\"X-Frame-Options\", \"DENY\");\n\t\tc.header(\"Referrer-Policy\", \"no-referrer\");\n\t\tc.header(\"Cache-Control\", \"no-store\");\n\t});\n\n\t// Caps every body parsed in memory before authentication or validation can reject it. RPC allows a batch of\n\t// agent attachments (the same 160 MiB ceiling as staged Vercel bodies); auth payloads are small JSON or forms.\n\tconst limitBody = (maxSize: number) =>\n\t\tbodyLimit({\n\t\t\tmaxSize,\n\t\t\tonError: (c) => {\n\t\t\t\tc.header(\"Cache-Control\", \"no-store\");\n\t\t\t\treturn c.json(\n\t\t\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\t\t\tdefined: false,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcode: \"PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tstatus: 413,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tmessage: \"This request is too large. Use a smaller file and try again.\",\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t\t413,\n\t\t\t\t);\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t});\n\tapp.use(\"/api/openapi/*\", limitBody(40 * 1024 * 1024));\n\t// Hono's `/x/*` also matches `/x`, so c.req.param(\"slug\"), client(c)),\n\t);\n\tapp.get(\"/api/resumes/:id/pdf\", (c) => handleResumePdfDownload(c.req.raw, c.req.param(\"id\")));\n\t// Outside /api/resumes, which robots.txt keeps -\".png\".length)),\n\t);\n\tapp.get(\"/api/uploads/*\", (c) => handleUpload(c.req.raw));\n\tapp.get(\"/uploads/*\", (c) => handleUpload(c.req.raw));\n\tapp.get(\"/schema.json\", () => handleSchemaJson());\n\tapp.get(\"/openapi.json\", () => handleOpenApiDocument());\n\tapp.all(\"/mcp/*\", (c) => handleMcp(c.req.raw, client(c)));\n\n\tapp.get(\"/.well-known/apple-app-site-association\", () => handleAppleAppSiteAssociation());\n\tapp.get(\"/.well-known/assetlinks.json\", () => handleAndroidAssetLinks());\n\tapp.get(\"/.well-known/integrations.json\", () => handleIntegrations());\n\t// Hono answers HEAD by running the GET route and dropping the body, headers => handleOAuthProtectedResource());\n\tapp.get(\"/.well-known/openai-apps-challenge\", () => handleOpenAiAppsChallenge());\n\tapp.all(\"/.well-known/*\", () =>       "content": "import { createResumePdfDownload, verifyResumePdfDownloadToken } from \"@reactive-resume/api/features/resume/export\";\n\nconst downloadHeaders = {\n\t\"Cache-Control\": \"private, no-store\",\n\t\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\",\n\t\"Referrer-Policy\": \"no-referrer\",\n};\n\nconst text = (body: string, status: number, extra: Record<string, string> = {}) =>\n\tnew Response(body, { status, headers: { ...downloadHeaders, ...extra } });\n\nfunction errorStatus(error: unknown) {\n\tconst code = typeof error === \"object\" && error && \"code\" in error ? (error as { code?: unknown }).code : undefined;\n\tif (code === \"TOO_MANY_REQUESTS\" || code === \"RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED\") return 429;\n\treturn code === \"NOT_FOUND\" ? 404 : 500;\n}\n\nexport async function handleResumePdfDownload(request: Request, id: string) {\n\tconst searchParams = new URL(request.url).searchParams;\n\tconst token = searchParams.get(\"token\");\n\tif (!token) return text(\"Unauthorized\", 401);\n\n\tconst verification = verifyResumePdfDownloadToken({ resumeId: id, token });\n\tif (!verification.ok)\n\t\treturn verification.reason === \"expired\" ? text(\"Download link expired\", 410) : text(\"Unauthorized\", 401);\n\t// Links made before letters left resumes may ask for the resume's cover letter, which is now a letter of its own.\n\tconst target = searchParams.get(\"target\");\n\tif (target && target !== \"resume\") return text(\"Not found\", 404);\n\n\ttry {\n\t\tconst resHeaders = new Headers();\n\t\tconst download = await createResumePdfDownload({ id, userId: verification.userId, resHeaders });\n\n\t\treturn new Response(download.body, {\n\t\t\theaders: {\n\t\t\t\t...Object.fromEntries(resHeaders),\n\t\t\t\t\"Content-Type\": download.body.type || \"application/pdf\",\n\t\t\t\t\"Content-Disposition\": download.headers[\"content-disposition\"],\n\t\t\t\t...downloadHeaders,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t});\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconst status = errorStatus(error);\n\t\tif (status === 500) console.error(\"[PDF Download]\", { name: error instanceof Error ? error.name : \"Unknown\" });\n\t\tconst reset =\n\t\t\ttypeof error === \"object\" && error && \"data\" in error ? (error.data as { reset?: number })?.reset : undefined;\n\t\tif (status !== 429) return text(\"Couldn't generate the resume PDF. Try again.\", status);\n\t\treturn text(\"Too many PDF exports. Try again in a few minutes.\", 429, {\n\t\t\t\"Retry-After\": String(reset ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil((reset - Date.now()) / 1000)) : 60),\n\t\t});\n\t}\n}\n"

      "content": "import { pathToFileURL } from \"node:url\";\nimport { serve } from \"@hono/node-server\";\nimport { env } from \"@reactive-resume/env/server\";\nimport { runStartupChecks } from \"./startup/checks\";\n\nexport async function main() {\n\tawait runStartupChecks();\n\n\t// Load and initialize auth only after migrations have created the provider tables.\n\tconst { createApp } = await import(\"./http/app\");\n\tconst { initializeAuth } = await import(\"@reactive-resume/auth/config\");\n\tawait initializeAuth();\n\tconst { startCareerScheduler } = await import(\"./startup/career-scheduler\");\n\n\t// Safety net: Node 24 crashes the whole process on an unhandled rejection. resolve(value: Rendered): void; reject(error: Error): void };\n\n// ponytail: one worker renders in order, so a preview can wait behind one thumbnail (~0.25 s); a second worker\n// for thumbnails costs another engine and font set in memory.\nlet worker: Worker | null | undefined;\nlet nextId = 0;\nconst pending = new Map<number, Pending>();\n\nfunction getWorker(): Worker | null {\n\tif (worker !== undefined) return worker;\n\tworker = null;\n\tif (typeof Worker === \"undefined\") return worker;\n\ttry {\n\t\tworker = new Worker(new URL(\"./pdf.worker.ts\", import.meta.url), { type: \"module\", name: \"resume-pdf\" });\n\t} catch {\n\t\treturn worker;\n\t}\n\tworker.addEventListener(\"message\", ({ data: response }: MessageEvent<PdfWorkerResponse>) => {\n\t\tconst request = pending.get(response.id);\n\t\tif (!request) return;\n\t\tpending.delete(response.id);\n\t\tif (\"error\" in response) request.reject(new Error(response.error, { cause: response.cause }));\n\t\telse request.resolve(response);\n\t});\n\t// Every render is caught inside the worker, so an error here means it couldn't start: render here instead.\n\tworker.addEventListener(\"error\", () => worker;\n}\n\nfunction render(input: RenderInput): Promise<Rendered> {\n\tconst target = getWorker();\n\tif (!target) return renderHere(input);\n\tconst id = ++nextId;\n\treturn new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n\t\tpending.set(id, { input, resolve, reject });\n\t\ttarget.postMessage({ ...input, id } satisfies PdfWorkerRequest);\n\t});\n}\n\nexport const createResumePdfBlob = async (\n\tdata: ResumeData,\n\trenderOptions?: RenderInput[\"renderOptions\"],\n\t{ onPageMap, onLostCharacters }: CreateResumePdfBlobExtras = {},\n) => {\n\tconst { blob, pageMap, lostCharacters } = await render({ data, renderOptions });\n\tif (pageMap) onPageMap?.(pageMap);\n\tif (lostCharacters) onLostCharacters?.(lostCharacters);\n\treturn blob;\n};\n"

      "content": "import type { ResumeExportTarget } from \"@reactive-resume/resume/export-sections\";\nimport type { ResumeData } from \"@reactive-resume/schema/resume/data\";\nimport { t } from \"@lingui/core/macro\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\nimport { getResumeExportData } from \"@reactive-resume/resume/export-sections\";\nimport { buildMarkdown } from \"@reactive-resume/resume/markdown\";\nimport { toast } from \"@reactive-resume/ui/components/toast\";\nimport { downloadWithAnchor } from \"@reactive-resume/utils/file\";\nimport { createResumePdfBlob } from \"./pdf-document\";\nimport { getLostCharactersMessage, getReadableErrorMessage } from \"@/libs/error-message\";\n\n// DOCX and ODT are large and only some exports need them; they load when one starts.\nconst loadDocx = () => import(\"@reactive-resume/docx\");\nconst loadOdt = () => import(\"@reactive-resume/odt\");\n\n/** Starts loading the DOCX and ODT builders, for controls that lead to those formats. */\nexport const preloadDocumentExport = () => {\n\tvoid loadDocx();\n\tvoid loadOdt();\n\tvoid import(\"@reactive-resume/pdf/section-title\");\n};\n\ntype ExportableResume = {\n\tname: string;\n\tslug: string;\n\tdata: ResumeData;\n};\n\ntype DownloadPdfOptions = {\n\tincludeCoverLetterHeader?: boolean;\n};\n\nexport type ExportFormat = \"pdf\" | \"docx\" | \"odt\" | \"md\" | \"json\";\n\n// Characters Windows and macOS won't take in a file name.\nconst UNSAFE_FILE_NAME_CHARACTERS = /[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]/g;\n\n/** A file name as the user typed it, minus the characters file systems reject. */\nexport const sanitizeFileName = (value: string) => value.replace(UNSAFE_FILE_NAME_CHARACTERS, \"\").trim();\n\n/**\n * \"First-Last-Resume\" (or \"First-Last-Cover-Letter\"): recruiters see this name. Without a name on the\n * resume it falls back to the document's name.\n */\nexport function getDefaultFileName(resume: ExportableResume, target: ResumeExportTarget = \"resume\") {\n\tconst words = (text: string) => sanitizeFileName(text).split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n\tconst person = words(resume.data.basics.name);\n\tconst suffix = target === \"cover-letter\" ? [\"Cover\", \"Letter\"] : [\"Resume\"];\n\tif (person.length > 0) return [...person, ...suffix].join(\"-\");\n\treturn [...words(resume.name || resume.slug), ...(target === \"cover-letter\" ? suffix : [])].join(\"-\") || \"Resume\";\n}\n\n// The file still downloads, with \"?\" for each character no font can draw.\nconst warnLostCharacters = (characters: string[]) =>\n\ttoast.add({ type: \"warning\", id: \"pdf-lost-characters\", description: getLostCharactersMessage(characters) });\n\n/** Builds one export file. It throws when the file can't be made, so each caller decides how to say so. */\nexport async function createExportFile(\n\tresume: ExportableResume,\n\tformat: ExportFormat,\n\ttarget: ResumeExportTarget = \"resume\",\n\toptions?: DownloadPdfOptions,\n): Promise<Blob> {\n\tif (format === \"json\") {\n\t\treturn new Blob([JSON.stringify(resume.data, null, 2)], { type: \"application/json\" });\n\t}\n\n\tconst data = getResumeExportData(resume.data, target);\n\tif (format === \"pdf\") {\n\t\treturn createResumePdfBlob(data, target === \"cover-letter\" ? options : undefined, {\n\t\t\tonLostCharacters: warnLostCharacters,\n\t\t});\n\t}\n\n\t// Section titles are stored empty by default; DOCX, ODT and Markdown use the PDF's localized headings.\n\tconst { getResumeSectionTitle } = await import(\"@reactive-resume/pdf/section-title\");\n\tconst resolveTitle = (sectionId: string) => getResumeSectionTitle(data, sectionId);\n\tif (format === \"md\") return new Blob([buildMarkdown(data, resolveTitle)], { type: \"text/markdown\" });\n\tif (format === \"odt\") return (await loadOdt()).buildOdt(data, resolveTitle);\n\treturn (await loadDocx()).buildDocx(data, resolveTitle);\n}\n\n/** Prints a PDF blob through a hidden iframe; if the browser blocks that, opens it in a new tab instead. */\nfunction printPdf(blob: Blob) {\n\tconst url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n\t// ponytail: print the generated PDF via a hidden iframe (reliable in Chromium). If the browser\n\t// blocks iframe printing, fall back to opening the PDF in a new tab so the user can print manually.\n\tconst iframe = document.createElement(\"iframe\");\n\tiframe.style.cssText = \"position:fixed;right:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:0;border:0\";\n\tiframe.src = url;\n\tiframe.onload = () => {\n\t\ttry {\n\t\t\tiframe.contentWindow?.focus();\n\t\t\tiframe.contentWindow?.print();\n\t\t} catch {\n\t\t\twindow.open(url, \"_blank\", \"noopener\");\n\t\t}\n\t\tsetTimeout(() => {\n\t\t\tiframe.remove();\n\t\t\tURL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n\t\t}, 60_000);\n\t};\n\tdocument.body.appendChild(iframe);\n}\n\n/** One-click exports that report their own progress and failures in toasts (the bar, ⌘P). */\nexport function useResumeExport(resume: ExportableResume) {\n\tconst [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false);\n\n\tconst onDownloadPDF = async () => {\n\t\tconst toastId = toast.add({\n\t\t\ttype: \"loading\",\n\t\t\tdescription: t`Generating PDF…`,\n\t\t});\n\t\tsetIsExporting(true);\n\t\ttry {\n\t\t\tconst blob = await createExportFile(resume, \"pdf\");\n\t\t\tdownloadWithAnchor(blob, `${getDefaultFileName(resume)}.pdf`);\n\t\t} catch (error) {\n\t\t\ttoast.add({\n\t\t\t\ttype: \"error\",\n\t\t\t\tdescription: getReadableErrorMessage(error, t`Couldn't generate the PDF. Try again.`),\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t}\n\t\tsetIsExporting(false);\n\t\ttoast.close(toastId);\n\t};\n\n\tconst onPrint = async () => {\n\t\tconst toastId = toast.add({ type: \"loading\", description: t`Preparing resume for printing…` });\n\t\tsetIsExporting(true);\n\t\ttry {\n\t\t\tprintPdf(await createResumePdfBlob(resume.data, undefined, { onLostCharacters: warnLostCharacters }));\n\t\t} catch (error) {\n\t\t\ttoast.add({\n\t\t\t\ttype: \"error\",\n\t\t\t\tdescription: getReadableErrorMessage(error, t`Couldn't prepare the resume for printing. Try again.`),\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t}\n\t\tsetIsExporting(false);\n\t\ttoast.close(toastId);\n\t};\n\n\treturn { onDownloadPDF, onPrint, isExporting };\n}\n"
    },

      "content": "import type { Locale } from \"@reactive-resume/utils/locale\";\nimport type { User } from \"better-auth\";\nimport { ORPCError, os } from \"@orpc/server\";\nimport { eq } from \"drizzle-orm\";\nimport { auth, verifyOAuthToken } from \"@reactive-resume/auth/config\";\nimport { getTrustedOrigins } from \"@reactive-resume/auth/trusted-origins\";\nimport { db } from \"@reactive-resume/db/client\";\nimport { user } from \"@reactive-resume/db/schema\";\nimport { env } from \"@reactive-resume/env/server\";\n\nexport type RequestPermission = \"read\" | \"write\" | \"delete\";\nexport type RequestAuthentication = {\n\tuser: User;\n\tmethod: \"apiKey\" | \"bearer\" | \"session\";\n\tpermissions: readonly RequestPermission[];\n};\n\ninterface ORPCContext {\n\tlocale: Locale;\n\treqHeaders: Headers;\n\tresHeaders?: Headers;\n\ttrustedClient?: string;\n\t/** Set only by a server adapter after authenticating this request. */\n\tauthentication?: RequestAuthentication | null;\n}\n\nconst TRUSTED_ORIGINS = getTrustedOrigins(env.APP_URL);\n// Public pages on the alias call the same API, including when incidental cookies are present.\nif (env.APP_ALIAS_URL) TRUSTED_ORIGINS.push(new URL(env.APP_ALIAS_URL).origin);\nconst fullPermissions: readonly RequestPermission[] = [\"read\", \"write\", \"delete\"];\n\nasync function findActiveUser(id: string): Promise<User | null> {\n\tconst [result] = await db.select().from(user).where(eq(user.id, id)).limit(1);\n\tif (!result || (result.banned && (!result.banExpires || result.banExpires > new Date()))) return null;\n\treturn result;\n}\n\nasync function getAuthenticationFromBearerToken(headers: Headers): Promise<RequestAuthentication | null> {\n\ttry {\n\t\tconst authHeader = headers.get(\"authorization\");\n\t\tif (!authHeader?.startsWith(\"Bearer \")) return null;\n\t\tconst payload = await verifyOAuthToken(authHeader.slice(7));\n\t\tif (!payload.sub) return null;\n\t\tconst result = await findActiveUser(payload.sub);\n\t\tif (!result) return null;\n\t\tconst scopes = typeof payload.scope === \"string\" ? payload.scope.split(/\\s+/) : [];\n\t\tconst explicitPermissions = scopes.filter((scope) => scope.startsWith(\"api:\"));\n\t\t// Existing grants used identity scopes for account-wide access. Explicit\n\t\t// application scopes opt into least privilege without breaking those grants.\n\t\tconst permissions = explicitPermissions.length\n\t\t\t? fullPermissions.filter((permission) => scopes.includes(`api:${permission}`))\n\t\t\t: fullPermissions;\n\t\treturn { user: result, method: \"bearer\", permissions };\n\t} catch {\n\t\treturn null;\n\t}\n}\n\nasync function getAuthenticationFromApiKey(apiKey: string): Promise<RequestAuthentication | null> {\n\ttry {\n\t\tconst result = await auth.api.verifyApiKey({ body: { key: apiKey } });\n\t\tif (!result.key || !result.valid) return null;\n\t\tconst activeUser = await findActiveUser(result.key.referenceId);\n\t\tif (!activeUser) return null;\n\t\tconst statements: unknown = result.key.permissions;\n\t\tconst apiPermissions = statements && typeof statements === \"object\" && \"api\" in statements ? statements.api : [];\n\t\tconst permissions =\n\t\t\tstatements == null\n\t\t\t\t? fullPermissions\n\t\t\t\t: fullPermissions.filter((permission) => Array.isArray(apiPermissions) && apiPermissions.includes(permission));\n\t\treturn { user: activeUser, method: \"apiKey\", permissions };\n\t} catch {\n\t\treturn null;\n\t}\n}\n\n/** API key, then OAuth bearer token, then same-origin session cookies. */\nexport async function resolveAuthenticationFromRequestHeaders(headers: Headers): Promise<RequestAuthentication | null> {\n\tconst apiKey = headers.get(\"x-api-key\");\n\tif (apiKey) {\n\t\tconst authentication = await getAuthenticationFromApiKey(apiKey);\n\t\tif (authentication) return authentication;\n\t}\n\tconst bearer = await getAuthenticationFromBearerToken(headers);\n\tif (bearer) return bearer;\n\tconst origin = headers.get(\"origin\");\n\tif (\n\t\theaders.has(\"cookie\") &&\n\t\t((origin && !TRUSTED_ORIGINS.includes(origin)) || headers.get(\"sec-fetch-site\") === \"cross-site\")\n\t) {\n\t\tthrow new ORPCError(\"FORBIDDEN\", {\n\t\t\tmessage: \"This request came from another site. Open Reactive Resume directly and try again.\",\n\t\t});\n\t}\n\t// Do not let Better Auth turn an API key into an unrestricted synthetic session.\n\tconst sessionHeaders = new Headers(headers);\n\tsessionHeaders.delete(\"x-api-key\");\n\tsessionHeaders.delete(\"authorization\");\n\ttry {\n\t\tconst result = await auth.api.getSession({ headers: sessionHeaders, query: { disableCookieCache: true } });\n\t\tif (!result?.user) return null;\n\t\tconst activeUser = await findActiveUser(result.user.id);\n\t\treturn activeUser ? { user: activeUser, method: \"session\", permissions: fullPermissions } : null;\n\t} catch {\n\t\treturn null;\n\t}\n}\n\nexport async function resolveUserFromRequestHeaders(headers: Headers): Promise<User | null> {\n\treturn (await resolveAuthenticationFromRequestHeaders(headers))?.user ?? null;\n}\n\nconst base = os.$context<ORPCContext>();\n\nexport const publicProcedure = base\n\t.route({ spec: (operation) => ({ ...operation, security: [] }) })\n\t.use(async ({ context, next }) => {\n\t\tconst authentication =\n\t\t\tcontext.authentication === undefined\n\t\t\t\t? await resolveAuthenticationFromRequestHeaders(context.reqHeaders)\n\t\t\t\t: context.authentication;\n\n\t\treturn next({\n\t\t\tcontext: {\n\t\t\t\t...context,\n\t\t\t\tauthentication,\n\t\t\t\tuser: authentication?.user ?? null,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t});\n\t});\n\n/**\n * The scope a route needs. Moving a document to Trash removes it like a delete, so its RPC and REST aliases need\n * `delete` too. MCP tools check the same rule before calling a procedure.\n */\nexport function requiredPermission(route: { method?: string | undefined; operationId?: string | undefined }) {\n\tif (route.method === \"GET\") return \"read\";\n\tif (route.method === \"DELETE\" || /^(delete|bulkDelete|purge|trash)|^putDocumentTrash$/i.test(route.operationId ?? \"\"))\n\t\treturn \"delete\";\n\treturn \"write\";\n}\n\nexport const protectedProcedure = publicProcedure\n\t.route({\n\t\tspec: (operation) => ({ ...operation, security: [{ apiKey: [] }, { bearerAuth: [] }, { cookieAuth: [] }] }),\n\t})\n\t.use(({ context, procedure, next }) => {\n\t\tif (!context.user) throw new ORPCError(\"UNAUTHORIZED\");\n\t\tconst permission = requiredPermission(procedure[\"~orpc\"].route);\n\t\tif (!context.authentication?.permissions.includes(permission)) {\n\t\t\tcontext.resHeaders?.set(\"WWW-Authenticate\", `Bearer error=\"insufficient_scope\", scope=\"api:${permission}\"`);\n\t\t\tthrow new ORPCError(\"FORBIDDEN\", {\n\t\t\t\tmessage: `This credential needs the api:${permission} permission. Use a credential that includes it.`,\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn next({\n\t\t\tcontext: {\n\t\t\t\t...context,\n\t\t\t\tuser: context.user,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t});\n\t});\n"

Respects ignored findings saved on the resume.\",\n\t})\n\t.input(z.object({ id: z.string().min(1) }))\n\t.output(\n\t\tz.object({\n\t\t\tfindings: z.array(finding).readonly(),\n\t\t\tignored: z.array(finding).readonly(),\n\t\t\tcounts: z.object({ error: z.number(), warning: z.number(), info: z.number() }),\n\t\t\ttotalRules: z.number(),\n\t\t\tpassedRules: z.number(),\n\t\t\tscore: z.number(),\n\t\t\tcategories: z.record(z.enum(ATS_CATEGORIES), z.object({ total: z.number(), passed: z.number() })),\n\t\t}),\n\t)\n\t.handler(async ({ input, context }) =>\n\t\tlintResumeForAts((await resumeService.getById({ id: input.id, userId: context.user.id })).data),\n\t);\n\nexport const checkPdf = publicProcedure\n\t.route({\n\t\tmethod: \"POST\",\n\t\tpath: \"/pdf-checks\",\n\t\ttags: [\"Checks\"],\n\t\toperationId: \"createPdfCheck\",\n\t\tsummary: \"Check a PDF for ATS readability\",\n\t\tdescription:\n\t\t\t\"Multipart PDF upload, up to 25 MB. Processes at most 30 pages, reports truncation and skipped checks, and stores nothing. Rate limited per client address. No authentication required.\",\n\t})\n\t.input(z.object({ file: z.file().max(25_000_000), jobDescription: z.string().max(20_000).optional() }))\n\t.output(\n\t\tpdfCheckSchema.extend({\n\t\t\tfullText: z.string().describe(\"Extracted text in reading order, for the optional AI review.\"),\n\t\t}),\n\t)\n\t.use(pdfAnalysisRateLimit)\n\t.handler(async ({ input, signal }) => {\n\t\tconst raw = await extractPdf(input.file, signal);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\t...analyzePdfResume(raw, input.jobDescription ? { jobDescription: input.jobDescription } : {}),\n\t\t\tfullText: buildExtractedDocument(raw).fullText,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n\nexport const matchResume = protectedProcedure\n\t.route({\n\t\tmethod: \"POST\",\n\t\tpath: \"/resumes/{id}/job-matches\",\n\t\ttags: [\"Checks\"],\n\t\toperationId: \"createResumeJobMatch\",\n\t\tsummary: \"Match resume terms to a job posting\",\n\t\tdescription:\n\t\t\t\"Runs the editor's deterministic term matching and respects terms hidden on this resume. No AI provider is needed.\",\n\t})\n\t.input(z.object({ id: z.string().min(1), jobDescription: z.string().trim().min(1).max(20_000) }))\n\t.output(\n\t\tz.object({\n\t\t\tfound: z.array(jobTermSchema.extend({ label: z.string() })),\n\t\t\tmissing: z.array(jobTermSchema.extend({ label: z.string() })),\n\t\t\ttotal: z.number(),\n\t\t}),\n\t)\n\t.handler(async ({ input, context }) => {\n\t\tconst { data } = await resumeService.getById({ id: input.id, userId: context.user.id });\n\t\tconst hidden = new Set(data.metadata.check?.hiddenTerms ?? []);\n\t\tconst terms = matchJobDescription({ jobDescription: input.jobDescription, resumeText: buildMarkdown(data) })\n\t\t\t.terms.filter((term) => !hidden.has(term.term))\n\t\t\t.map((term) => ({\n\t\t\t\t...term,\n\t\t\t\tlabel:\n\t\t\t\t\tsurfaceFormsOf(term.term)\n\t\t\t\t\t\t.map((form) => input.jobDescription.match(new RegExp(RegExp.escape(form), \"i\"))?.[0])\n\t\t\t\t\t\t.find(Boolean) ?? term.term,\n\t\t\t}));\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tfound: terms.filter((term) => term.resumeCount > 0),\n\t\t\tmissing: terms.filter((term) => term.resumeCount === 0),\n\t\t\ttotal: terms.length,\n\t\t};\n\t});\n"
    },

Requires authentication.\",\n\t\t\tsuccessDescription: \"The ID of the newly created resume.\",\n\t\t})\n\t\t.input(resumeDto.create.input)\n\t\t.use(resumeMutationRateLimit)\n\t\t.output(resumeDto.create.output)\n\t\t.errors({\n\t\t\t...slugErrors,\n\t\t})\n\t\t.handler(({ context, input }) =>\n\t\t\tresumeService.create({\n\t\t\t\tname: input.name,\n\t\t\t\t...(input.slug ? { slug: input.slug } : {}),\n\t\t\t\t...(input.autoName ? { autoName: true } : {}),\n\t\t\t\ttags: input.tags,\n\t\t\t\tlocale: context.locale,\n\t\t\t\tuserId: context.user.id,\n\t\t\t\tdata: createResumeData({\n\t\t\t\t\twithSampleData: input.withSampleData,\n\t\t\t\t\tname: context.user.name,\n\t\t\t\t\tlocale: context.locale,\n\t\t\t\t}),\n\t\t\t}),\n\t\t),\n\n\timport: protectedProcedure\n\t\t.route({\n\t\t\tmethod: \"POST\",\n\t\t\tpath: \"/resumes/import\",\n\t\t\ttags: [\"Resumes\"],\n\t\t\toperationId: \"importResume\",\n\t\t\tsummary: \"Import a resume\",\n\t\t\tdescription:\n\t\t\t\t\"Creates a new resume from an existing ResumeData object (e.g. from a previously exported JSON file).       "path": "packages/api/src/features/resume/export.ts",
      "content": "import { ORPCError } from \"@orpc/server\";\nimport z from \"zod\";\nimport { env } from \"@reactive-resume/env/server\";\nimport { generateFilename } from \"@reactive-resume/utils/file\";\nimport { protectedProcedure } from \"../../context\";\nimport { consumePdfExportLimit } from \"../../middleware/rate-limit\";\nimport { parseStoredResumeData } from \"./resume-data-validation\";\nimport { resumeService } from \"./service\";\n\nexport { createResumePdfDownloadUrl, verifyResumePdfDownloadToken } from \"./pdf-download-url\";\n\ntype CreateResumePdfDownloadInput = {\n\tid: string;\n\tuserId: string;\n\tresHeaders?: Headers;\n};\n\nexport async function createResumePdfDownload(input: CreateResumePdfDownloadInput) {\n\tconst resume = await resumeService.getById({ id: input.id, userId: input.userId });\n\tawait consumePdfExportLimit(input);\n\tconst data = parseStoredResumeData(resume.data);\n\tconst filename = generateFilename(resume.name, \"pdf\");\n\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Lazy-load the PDF renderer (@reactive-resume/pdf → the Forme WASM engine and\n\t\t// the icon drawings) only when a PDF is actually exported, instead of at server\n\t\t// boot. Keeps cold starts light on constrained/slow-disk hosts.\n\t\tconst { createResumePdfFile } = await import(\"@reactive-resume/pdf/server\");\n\t\tconst body = await createResumePdfFile({ data, filename, uploadOrigin: env.APP_URL });\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\theaders: {\n\t\t\t\t\"content-disposition\": `attachment; filename=\"${filename}\"`,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tbody,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tif (error instanceof Error && error.cause === \"pdf-text-loss\") {\n\t\t\tthrow new ORPCError(\"BAD_REQUEST\", { message: error.message });\n\t\t}\n\t\tconsole.error(\"[PDF API] Failed to render resume PDF\", { resumeId: input.id, error });\n\t\tthrow new ORPCError(\"INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR\", { message: \"Couldn't generate the resume PDF. Try again.\" });\n\t}\n}\n\nexport const downloadResumePdfProcedure = protectedProcedure\n\t.route({\n\t\tmethod: \"GET\",\n\t\tpath: \"/resumes/{id}/pdf\",\n\t\ttags: [\"Resumes\"],\n\t\toperationId: \"downloadResumePdf\",\n\t\tsummary: \"Download resume as PDF\",\n\t\tdescription:\n\t\t\t\"Generates a PDF for the specified resume and returns it as a forced download. Only resumes belonging to the authenticated user can be downloaded. Requires authentication.\",\n\t\tsuccessDescription: \"The generated resume PDF.\",\n\t\toutputStructure: \"detailed\",\n\t})\n\t.input(\n\t\tz.object({\n\t\t\tid: z.string().describe(\"The ID of the resume.\"),\n\t\t\ttarget: z\n\t\t\t\t.literal(\"resume\")\n\t\t\t\t.optional()\n\t\t\t\t.describe(\"Deprecated, only `resume`: cover letters are documents of their own (`/cover-letters`).\"),\n\t\t}),\n\t)\n\t.output(\n\t\tz.object({\n\t\t\theaders: z.object({\n\t\t\t\t\"content-disposition\": z.string(),\n\t\t\t}),\n\t\t\tbody: z.file().mime(\"application/pdf\"),\n\t\t}),\n\t)\n\t.handler(({ context, input }) =>\n\t\tcreateResumePdfDownload({\n\t\t\tid: input.id,\n\t\t\tuserId: context.user.id,\n\t\t\t...(context.resHeaders && { resHeaders: context.resHeaders }),\n\t\t}),\n\t);\n"
    },

      "content": "import { ORPCError } from \"@orpc/server\";\nimport { harvestPdfDocument } from \"@reactive-resume/resume/ats-pdf\";\n\n/** Server adapter for the same bounded extraction used by the browser's checker and importer. */\nexport async function extractPdf(file: File, signal?: AbortSignal, operatorBudgetMs = 30_000) {\n\tconst data = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());\n\tif (file.size > 25_000_000 || ![0x25, 0x50, 0x44, 0x46].every((byte, index) => data[index] === byte)) {\n\t\tthrow new ORPCError(\"BAD_REQUEST\", { message: \"Provide a PDF no larger than 25 MB.\" });\n\t}\n\tconst { getDocument } = await import(\"pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs\");\n\tconst task = getDocument({ data, fontExtraProperties: true, useSystemFonts: false });\n\tconst timeout = AbortSignal.timeout(45_000);\n\tconst aborted = signal ?
